changes: Normalize Excel worksheet names before XML escaping so long names cannot truncate XML entities; remove invalid worksheet-name characters and preserve whole Unicode characters.
Remove characters forbidden by XML while retaining tabs/newlines, preserve whitespace and keep formula-like user text as inline strings and numeric amounts as numbers.
Distinguish loading/failed finance-alert reads from a verified empty result, retain prior rows and ignore stale or canceled responses.
Label finance alert counts as loaded records and show the existing 50-record server limit explicitly instead of claiming a global total.
Use aligned compact navigation buttons, readable boxed alerts and responsive summary cards.

verification.xlsx_scope: Four generated XLSX fixtures independently unzipped and parsed with .NET XML readers; entity-boundary names, invalid names, Unicode, numeric amounts, literal formulas, whitespace and columns beyond Z checked.
verification.data_scope: Synthetic in-memory downloads and controlled alert reads; no real finance records changed.

limitations: Finance alerts retain the existing server's selection and 50-record limit; these UI fixes do not turn the alert list into a full ledger reconciliation.
manual_checks_pending: Visual browser review and opening exported files in the user's Excel application after deployment.
